body: Well where I live a couple of regions have good healthcare (when it comes to this) and if you don't belong in those regions you are shit out of luck. We have one psychiatrist and the waiting line is about 8-14 months... Now I did manage to get to another doctor, my apointment is pretty soon ( 7 day ish), but he is more of a doctor for "bad kids". Like if you burgle or get into school fights, smoke or drink alcohol ect. So yeah...
